Scheme facts for HDFC Equity Fund.
HDFC Equity Fund is listed on Groww as HDFC Flexi Cap Direct Plan Growth. HDFC Equity Fund and HDFC Flexi Cap Direct Plan Growth are the same scheme, so every fact below applies to both names.
Source URL: https://groww.in/mutual-funds/hdfc-equity-fund-direct-growth.
Fund manager: Dhruv Muchhal.
Fund managers: Dhruv Muchhal (managing since Jun 2023), Amit Ganatra (managing since Feb 2026).
Expense ratio: 0.74%.

Exit load: Exit load of 1% if redeemed within 1 year.
Riskometer classification: Very High Risk.
Benchmark index: NIFTY 500 Total Return Index.
Latest NAV: Rs. 2,295.28. (as of 13 Aug 2026).
Fund size (AUM): Rs. 1,10,736.41 Cr.
